[EN] It seems the Kulkari have their own unique chain of command. Those {@LinkCreature:21#5#Crag Stalker Prophets} and {@LinkCreature:21#30#Crag Stalker shamans} over there are like the commanders.

To the prophets and shamans, as well as the combatants under their control, the staves they carry around are holy. If we take their staves, we will effectively eliminate their objects of worship.

Once their faith starts to falter, their will to fight will soon follow.
[ES] Parece que los kulkari tienen su propia cadena de mando única. Esos {@LinkCreature:21#5#Crag Stalker Prophets} y {@LinkCreature:21#30#Crag Stalker shamans} de allí actúan como los comandantes.

Para los profetas y chamanes, así como para los combatientes bajo su control, los báculos que llevan son sagrados. Si les quitamos sus báculos, eliminaremos efectivamente sus objetos de culto.

Una vez que su fe empiece a flaquear, su voluntad de luchar no tardará en hacer lo mismo.

[EN] Look over there! Unrest stewing among the Crag Stalkers, just as we planned! You've done an excellent job.
[ES] ¡Mira hacia allá! ¡Se está gestando inquietud entre los Crag Stalkers, tal como lo planeamos! Has hecho un trabajo excelente.

[EN] The best way to break their morale in half is to eliminate the very objects they worship. You should perhaps hurry up.
[ES] La mejor manera de destruir su moral por completo es eliminar los objetos mismos que veneran. Tal vez deberías darte prisa.
